extension.name: ONNX FP32 optimized serving with dynamic INT8 evaluation
extension.evidence: BENCHMARKS.md and Lab 8 optimization/serving notebook; ONNX FP32 met the project budget with 340.68 ms p95 model-only latency, 30.99 items/s throughput, 1.0 prediction agreement, and 0.0 quality tax. Dynamic INT8 was evaluated but rejected because its quality tax was 0.5655.
